page: Microsoft Azure E128ads_v7 is an enterprise memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V architecture. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 64 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 1024 GB of memory, yielding 8 GB per vCPU and 16 GB per physical core. Per-core cache architecture provides 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 32 MB L3 cache pool. Hardware vector extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, alongside AES, VAES, and SHA cryptographic acceleration instructions. For high-speed temporary scratch space and caching, the instance integrates 7559 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage.

Empirical benchmarks place the instance within the top decile across processor, memory, and database workloads. In stress-ng evaluations, the multi-core CPU score reached 232766.23 alongside a single-core score of 3778.89. Uncached memory read bandwidth recorded 402.39 GB/sec on large blocks, while write bandwidth achieved 202.2 GB/sec. Data manipulation metrics show high sustained throughput, with multi-threaded bzip3 decompression attaining 850.97 GB/sec and static web serving reaching 104.86 GB/sec. The instance demonstrated 171.99 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations, reflecting high cache and memory access speeds. CPU-based small and medium language model prompt processing achieved top-tier throughput of 5756.53 and 311.0 tokens per second, respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the consolidation of 128 high-frequency vCPUs, a full terabyte of memory, and over 7.5 TB of bundled NVMe storage minimizes the architectural overhead of managing multi-node clusters. However, the instance includes zero GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, making it unsuitable for GPU-accelerated deep learning pipelines or bare external internet routing without additional networking configuration. The E128ads_v7 is primarily aligned with memory-bound enterprise software, including in-memory datastores like Redis or Memcached, large relational database management systems, big data processing engines, and memory-heavy transactional backends.
description: Microsoft Azure E128ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by 64 physical cores and 128 dedicated vCPUs from the AMD EPYC 9V45 processor family, running up to 4.5 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. With 1024 GB of system memory, the instance delivers an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside 7559 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage. The AMD processor integrates AVX-512 vector extensions, including BF16 and VNNI, enabling strong instruction throughput and cryptographic performance. Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the top tier across multi-core compute, uncached memory bandwidth exceeding 400 GB/sec for reads, and database operations reaching 171.99 million Redis SET operations per second. The lack of integrated GPUs limits its application for accelerated graphics or massive parallel training, but its resource density provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for consolidating distributed infrastructure. The E128ads_v7 is targeted at large in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, intensive caching tiers, and enterprise transactional database environments.
